errors.evidence: The x-axis is labeled at every power of 2 from 2^9 to 2^20, not every other power of 2.
The red line (Intent) is at approximately 5.7 at x=2^17, not 6.0.
The blue line (Summary) approaches but does not reach 6.0. Its value is approximately 5.9-5.95 from 2^17 onwards.
The yellow line (Law) starts at approximately 3.6 at 2^9, not 4.0.
For the yellow line (Law), the value at 2^14 is approximately 5.8, not 6.0.
The purple line (Translation) dips at 2^11 to a value of approximately 5.0. At 2^12, its value is approximately 5.6, not 4.6.
The purple line (Translation) reaches a value of approximately 5.8 at 2^16, not 6.0.
The grey line (Code) does not increase steadily; it has a noticeable peak around 2^13 and a dip at 2^14 before continuing to rise.
The green line (Math) reaches a value of approximately 5.9 at 2^20, not 6.0.
